Neumorphic for SwiftUI

A March 2020 SwiftUI package whose demo is a catalogue of raised and pressed shapes in light and dark modes.

Source
costachung/neumorphic on GitHub
Creator
Costa Chung
Made
2020–present (repository created 23 March 2020)
Style
Neumorphism (agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)
Moods
Soft, calm
Evidence
Inspected the README demo image (1000 × 800) hosted on user-images.githubusercontent.com. Licence and dates read through the GitHub API.
Reviewed
28 September 2026
Rights
Link and metadata only. License: unverified. Rights policy

Context

The README says it is “a SwiftUI utility to build Neumorphism Soft UI”, written because in SwiftUI “we can’t easily create inner shadow”.

MIT License. It had about 1,000 GitHub stars on 2026-09-28. Later versions add text fields, sliders, pickers, and accessibility helpers for contrast.

Observed

  • Two iPhone frames side by side: one pale blue-gray, one dark charcoal.
  • In each, a pressed square and a pressed circle, a raised ring and a pressed ring, three small squares (raised, pressed, flat), a wide “Soft Button”, and a round heart button.
  • The light version has white highlights at upper left and blue-gray shadows at lower right; the dark version uses a slightly lighter edge and a black shadow.
  • One red circular button with a white heart is the only color. Text is gray system sans-serif.

Why it belongs

The paired light and dark sheets show that the effect holds on a dark surface only when the highlight is a lighter gray, not white.
